items.title: Base Activity Climbs To 7.5 Million Transactions In A Day
items.summary: TL;DR Base network activity reached roughly 7.5 million transactions over a single day in the validated September 22 data. The count includes all recorded transactions, including low-value and automated activity. High transaction count is a usage metric, not proof of equivalent economic value. Base has pushed daily transaction activity to roughly 7.5 million, adding another scale milestone for Coinbase’s Ethereum Layer 2 ecosystem.
